info.title: agentorg
info.summary: The record of agents, their sessions, asks to managers, and messages up.

post.summary: Create an agent: a work responsibility managed by the acting session's agent.
post.description: Returns the new agent; put its id in the brief of the session that will attach to it. Agents directly under the user come only from new_agent at attach.

post.summary: Close a child agent whose work is done, and return the cleanup list.
post.description: Closing detaches its session and withdraws its open asks. Only its manager's sessions close it, once its own children are closed.

post.summary: List the agent tree, each agent with its status and what waits on it: open asks addressed to it and unread messages to it.
Read one agent with its sessions, the asks it opened and the asks addressed to it, and its messages. It marks nothing read.
Attach this session to an agent and return the facts it acts on.
post.description: Call it first, with the agent id from your brief. When the user started you with an appointment in words and no agent id, name new_agent instead, once. Attaching ends any earlier session of the agent. The facts are the agent, its manager, its children with their status, the open asks addressed to it, its own asks with any answers, and its inbox. Keep the session id it returns: every write names it as session.

post.summary: Read the facts session_attach returns, for a client session already attached, without changing anything.
post.description: The facts are null when no session with that client session id is attached.

post.summary: Set the status of the session's agent: its state, a short plain-text summary, links and blockers.
post.description: Its manager and the user see it. It is a status, not a log.

post.summary: Ask the agent's manager a question. It is addressed to the manager automatically; when the manager is the user, it appears on the decisions page.
post.description: Give context for a reader outside the session, two to six options and the label you recommend. To carry a child's ask up, list it in escalates. Then keep working and read the answer with ask_get or your next session_attach, or wait with ask_wait when you cannot go on without it.

post.summary: Read an ask, with its answer once it has one.
Wait until an ask is answered or withdrawn and return it.
post.description: With a timeout, return the ask after that long even if it is still open.

post.summary: Withdraw an open ask that no longer needs an answer. Only the asking agent's sessions may.
Answer an open ask addressed to the session's agent, with a choice, words, or both.
post.description: Answer it yourself when you can. When only your manager can, escalate it: open your own ask with the child's ask in escalates, and answer the child once you have the answer.

post.summary: Record an answer the user gave in the asking session's own conversation, for an ask addressed to the user. Quote the user's words exactly.
List every ask in a state, oldest first, whoever it is addressed to, with the agents it refers to.
Send a note or a report to the agent's manager. Messages only go up; the manager reads them when it chooses.
Read the agent's unread messages and the reports it has not acknowledged, and mark them read.
Acknowledge a report to the agent after reviewing it. Only its recipient may.
Mint a one-time link that signs the browser in to the decisions page.

manager.description: The managing agent; null when the user is the manager.

created_by.description: The session that created it: its manager's, or the session that attached with new_agent.

created_at_attach.description: True when a session created it directly under the user as it attached, on the user's appointment in words.

state.description: Pending until a session first attaches, then active, then closed.

session.description: A session of the agent's manager.

detached_sessions.description: The session closing detached, if one was attached.

AgentCloseResult.description: The cleanup list for the manager.

session.description: The acting session; the new agent is a child of its agent.

title.description: The responsibility, such as "Migrate session storage".

purpose.description: What the agent is for, for a reader outside the session.

own_asks.description: Every ask the agent opened, with the manager each went to.

addressed_asks.description: Every ask addressed to the agent.

messages.description: Messages from the agent and to it.

sessions.description: Every session that attached to it, newest first.

AgentDetail.description: One agent in full; reading it marks nothing read.

asks_to_answer.description: Open asks addressed to the agent.

unread_messages.description: Unread messages addressed to the agent.

choice.description: The label of the chosen option, if one was chosen.

by.description: The answering agent; null when the user answered.

to.description: The asking agent's manager; null when it is the user.

escalates.description: The asks addressed to the asking agent that this one carries up.

session.description: A session of the agent the ask is addressed to.

choice.description: The label of the chosen option.

words.description: A note in the answerer's own words.

state.description: Null lists asks in every state.

agents.description: The agents the asks come from and go to, for building escalation chains.

session.description: The asking session; the ask goes to its agent's manager.

title.description: The decision, as a short question.

context.description: Two or three sentences for a reader outside the session.

recommendation.description: The label of the recommended option.

escalates.description: Open asks addressed to the asking agent that this ask carries up to its manager.

session.description: A session of the asking agent, in whose conversation the user answered.

ask.description: An ask of that agent addressed to the user.

choice.description: The option those words choose, if any.

timeout_seconds.description: Return the ask, still open, after this long; null waits until it is settled.

session.description: A session of the asking agent; only it withdraws the ask.
The acting session, when the request names one.

target.description: The record the operation acted on.

outcome.description: "ok", or the error code the operation returned.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every API error response.

manager.description: Null when the user is the manager.

children.description: The agent's children that are not closed, with their status.

asks_to_answer.description: Open asks addressed to the agent.

own_asks.description: The agent's own asks that are open or answered.

inbox.description: Unread messages, and reports not yet acknowledged.

Facts.description: What a session acts on, facts only: the skill decides how to act on them.

messages.description: Unread messages, and reports not yet acknowledged, oldest first.

session.description: A session of the reading agent.

path.description: The page path that signs in: /ui/login?token=... It works once.

to.description: The sender's manager; null when it is the user.

body.description: Plain text with line breaks, organized at the sender's level.

acknowledged_at.description: Reports only: set when the recipient reviewed it.

session.description: A session of the report's recipient.
The sending session; the message goes to its agent's manager.

NewAgent.description: An agent to create directly under the user.

label.description: The button text; unique within the ask.

id.description: Issued by the service; writes name it as `session`.

client.description: The client kind, such as "claude-code" or "codex".

client_session_id.description: The client's own id for the conversation.

detached_at.description: Set when another session attached to the agent.

agent.description: The agent to act for, from the brief its manager wrote.

new_agent.description: Instead of agent: create an agent directly under the user and attach to it, when the user started this session with an appointment in words. Allowed only on the client session's first attach.

client.description: Defaults to the client the transport names.

client_session_id.description: Defaults to the one the transport carries.

machine.description: Defaults to the service's host name.

client.description: Defaults to the client the transport names.

client_session_id.description: Defaults to the one the transport carries.

facts.description: Null when no session with this client session id is attached.

summary.description: Plain text; line breaks are kept.

Status.description: The agent's status, set by its attached session.

summary.description: Plain text, never a log; line breaks are kept.
